Ambrose Hale left Cedar Bluff on the Monday stage and did not come back.
The farms along Willow Creek went back to the people who had worked them,
and when the railroad built its water tower two years later,
it paid Hannah Cole a fair price for the land under it.
Lavinia Hale never ran the sign-up table again.
